about: rqgm_check.py selftest: each case runs 'audit' on one fixture and must match exactly. codes = [code, class] multiset of all findings; [] = no findings of any class. Cases with a source field are archives from runs/2026-09-25-peer/checker-attack/ (copied verbatim); ruling says whether the checker was changed for them or the break was ruled not a checker defect.

cases.note: r1: slot-1 orders disagree (UNKNOWN), slot 2 variant, slot 3 skipped, kept. r2: UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN skips slot 3; r2-b logs slot 1 'variant' for orders [variant, tie] (recomputed UNKNOWN; still 2 of 3, kept)
two variants with outcome kept in one round
r1: slot 2 rates protected c2 (passed at setup) best; r2: slots variant, variant, best
strict probe; keep on 2 variant + 1 tie; strict Check votes pass,pass,fail logged pass; source c2 logged pass while its only citation is contradicted
shorter variant kept on tie,tie with no slot 3; then on 3 ties with a slot-3 per-criterion UNKNOWN; r3: tie,tie never skips judge 3 (a shorter variant could have been pruned)

slot 1 retried twice; slot 2 ERROR after one retry with no completed objection logged as rejected; a gate retried twice; HALT(ERROR) after a single all-ERROR round; the round proposes 3 variants (VARIANT_COUNT, RECORD: none kept)
best passes c1 (setup check), variant fails c1, judged and kept (paired positive: p23_imperfect_v0 r1); screen-rejected variants: judged anyway, logged dropped, kept
v2.parent = v0 while v1 was kept; r3 keeps with round.kept null and logs no version; next round is n=5; a version follows a round that kept nothing

r1-3 all dropped (r3 logged instead of HALT(ERROR)); exit STALL at s=0; resume names round 5; s reaches 3 and r7 runs with no Check; the Check fails at s=4 and r8 runs instead of HALT(STALL); the exit at record 8 names STALL while HALT(ERROR) is still due after a third all-ERROR round (two or more in a row halt: checker-attack round2 a37)

second Check on v1/E1 with no version, rung or amend between; a Check on v0 while v1 is best; exit STALL on the standing failing Check at s=0; the record-12 amend leaves DONE byte-identical, so the record-13 Check is still a re-roll (checker-attack fn14; a DONE-changing amend reopens it, fn16)
rounds=5, round 6 starts with 10 of 70 minutes left (longest round 10); exit BUDGET with no standing Check

a round after an all-pass Check below the final rung; rung E2 then a round with no probe{rung:E2}; rung E3 with no earlier amend; the E3 probe misses the seeded defect but is logged normal; v3: with no E2 probe the rung is strict (fail closed), so the record-12 2/2 keep is STRICT_KEEP with slot 3 missing

COMPLETE at E1 with final_rung E2; held-out run at E2 before any E2 Check; COMPLETE reusing the E1 pass; after the E2 Check every COMPLETE condition holds but PARTIAL is logged; a record after exit without resume
held-out attempt 2 on the same version as failed attempt 1; it fails and a round runs instead of HALT(OVERFIT)
--done file makes c2 optional; no amend record
kept diff edits check file test_public.py; --target hash differs from setup.check_hashes
held-out run and exit COMPLETE while a required substrate is open; the optional-gap positive is in p23_complete_spare
final version line cut mid-JSON: excluded, best stays v1
complete final line without its newline (read in memory): excluded as torn, so v1 never becomes best
line 7 of 20 corrupt: integrity error, nothing after it audited
version.diff differs from the judged diff
two eligible variants, equal support and words, the second kept; then two eligible variants and none kept

r2 undoes r1's kept edit of S1 exactly and r3 runs with no HALT(OSCILLATION): an exact undo needs no "(nearly)" judgment, so a VIOLATION (checker-attack round2 a38; a near restore stays AMBIGUOUS, fp13); a later HALT(OSCILLATION) on unrelated text is advisory
v2 records (string verdicts, no gates, check{rung,pass}, halt) and one malformed field (a list as a gap key): rules are unauditable, never violated, never a crash
v0 fails c1; a shared c1 failure is kept (P07 paired positive); then c1 fixed; human stops at E1
valid prune: shorter, 3 completed slots, none best or UNKNOWN
--pending answer key: equal support, fewer words wins

honest HALT(STALL) twice (v0's setup Check logged without a trigger, as SKILL.md's schema allows): three merit stalls and a failing stall Check; then, after a keep, a held-out failure on an unchanged best that stalls for three rounds
two all-ERROR rounds then HALT(ERROR); ERROR rounds are not stalls
held-out fails on v1, v2 kept and Checked at E2, spare passes, COMPLETE; optional gap open (P17 positive)
torn version line set aside, resume, round 2 rerun from v1
without --first both violations (records 12 and 30) are reported
--first stops at record 12 and evaluates nothing later
slot 2 returned best, then a second slot-2 verdict (variant) is logged and the variant kept: the first verdict per slot stands
slot 1 UNKNOWN, slot 2 variant, slot 3 tie; a slot-4 variant verdict is ignored, so support is 1
strict: slots 1-3 variant, variant, tie; a slot-4 variant verdict cannot supply the third vote
the E1 probe is strict; a second, clean E1 probe cannot relax it; the 2/2 keep is a strict-mode violation

v3 archive: probe with identity [] and seeded.pair [] logs no comparison (SKILL Probe: "judge 1 compares *best*, in both orders"): RECORD_MISSING, and the E1 rung is strict (fail closed), so the 2/2 keep is STRICT_KEEP with slot 3 missing
a check{trigger:setup} on v0 after round 1 is an ordinary Check (on a non-best version), so c1 stays pass for best and r2-a failing c1 is a regression
the stall Check on best v0 is logged with trigger setup after 3 rounds; it still stands, fails c2, and round 4 runs instead of HALT(STALL)
v3 archive: kept variant has gates.commands {} while c1 is a DONE command ("run every command there yourself"): RECORD_MISSING, and the keep is not credited
v3 archive: kept variant has no gates.screen (gates:{apply,commands,verifier,screen}; "Gate, in order"): RECORD_MISSING, and the keep is not credited
slot 2 overall UNKNOWN with criteria {c2: best} (c2 passed at setup): a per-criterion veto counts whatever the overall
rung{E1} re-logged at E1 is not an escalation: it neither resets the stall count nor clears the due Check
c3 votes [fail,fail,fail,pass,pass] logged pass: extra votes count against a pass (majority of all asked)
strict: c3 votes [pass,pass,pass,fail] logged pass: strict needs every judge asked
an amend whose done equals the current DONE changes nothing: the failing Check on v1/E1 stands
two all-ERROR rounds, a DONE-identical amend, then round 3: HALT(ERROR) was due (an amend never clears it)
the only held-out pass predates an amend adding required c4: held-out results stand only until DONE changes
round 2 keeps new text under the old id v1: no Check or held-out result recorded before it stands
6 round records logged n=1,2,3,1,2,3 under budget.rounds=3: rounds are counted from records

ruling: a second round record numbered 2 is a separate round (new best v2, new variant) with a wrong number; each keeps one variant on valid support and the budget counts it, so only ROUND_SEQUENCE (RECORD)
round clocks restart at 0 after a resume: loop time continues from the last round end, so rounds 6 and 7 start with < 2x the longest round left
heldout.pass {c3: "fail"}: any value other than true fails closed
a required gap re-logged waived with no amend after it opened stays open
required gap with status "OPEN": any status other than closed or waived is open
setup.done.final_rung E3 vs top-level setup.final_rung E1: DONE applies and the conflict is reported

ruling: escalation is the human's decision (rung{name, by:human}); the prose restricts when the loop pauses, not when the human may escalate, and COMPLETE rests on an all-pass E2 Check and a held-out pass
held-out attempt 1 on the spare set: flagged, and its pass does not count toward COMPLETE
r2-a has diff [] yet claims 99 < 100 words: an empty diff changes nothing, so it is neither shorter nor keepable
kept diff edits Tests/Test_Public.py; check file tests/test_public.py: paths compare case-insensitively
six variants in one round, the sixth kept (VIOLATION; extra proposals kept nothing would be RECORD); its diff edits two sections (advisory: an approved restructure is not recorded)
round 2 re-proposes round 1's exact diff, rejected by 2 judges, with no citation logged since: advisory, because "absent new evidence" is a judgment
slot 1 orders [best, variant, variant]: the first two stand (UNKNOWN), so slot 1 is no support
budget.rounds 3.0 is a number: rounds 4 and 5 overrun
the stall Check leaves required c3 unchecked (not pass): HALT(STALL) is due and every later record misses it (pairs with fp01)

a required gap closed with no evidence field. Rechecked for v3 fail closed: SKILL.md's substrate{gap,owner,required,status} has no evidence field and no record ties a citation to a gap ("the human closes it with evidence the Verifier checks" names no record), so the closure stays unauditable even on a v3 archive
honest HALT(STALL) after a stall Check leaving required c3 unchecked (votes pass, ERROR, ERROR)
ruling: SKILL.md and INITIATOR.md step 3 now read "reject the variant" (the attack quoted older wording), so an early rejection logged dropped is still flagged
judge 1 best (med), judge 2 ERROR after one retry: "Retry an ERROR once, then drop the variant (not a rejection)", so two such rounds support HALT(ERROR)

an amend without done on a v3 archive: SKILL.md Memory lists amend{what,why,done}, so it is RECORD_MISSING; with DONE unknown the COMPLETE is not credited (FALSE_COMPLETE). A non-v3 archive keeps the unauditable ruling
cases.ruling: v3 fail closed (supersedes the unauditable ruling)

cases.note: a valid COMPLETE archive saved with a UTF-8 BOM: the BOM is not content
a clean probe logged strict: strict by choice only makes keeps and passes harder (fail closed), so the declined 2/3 keep is correct
the human takes 12 hours to escalate: waits after rung, amend, held-out, exit or resume are not loop time
a verified citation without a criterion field: whether c2 has a verified source is unauditable, not failed
retries "0" (a string): the retry rule is unauditable and the round is otherwise audited
two equally supported eligible variants, one without words (variants[{id,section,words,...}]; "then shorter"): on a v3 archive the tie-break input is RECORD_MISSING
cases.ruling: v3 fail closed (supersedes the unauditable ruling)

cases.note: after exit OSCILLATION the human picks v1 over v2; the next round names v1 as best
HALT(OSCILLATION) before the version; the human picks the variant and its version follows the resume
rung E3, then the amend adding the objective, then probe E3: the amend only has to precede the E3 probe or round
two keeps change different phrases of Aims; each moves away from the older text, so nothing is restored
version diff = judged section/old/new plus a file key: the applied text is the judged text
v2 archive: kept variant, no version, resume: no snapshot to restore, never a crash
a second setup record (same DONE, no t0) after a timed round is ignored and reported, never a crash
audit --target with setup.check_files [["tests","t.py"]]: the non-path entry is unauditable, never a crash
last line is 200000 unclosed brackets: a torn tail, not a RecursionError
--pending file is a JSON list: a usage error (exit 2), never a crash

v3 fail closed: a rejected variant with no gates and a kept variant whose slot-1 verdict has no orders (record 5); a round with no t0/t1 and a verdict with no retries (7); a judges Check pass with no votes, not credited (8); an exit with no status (9)
positive control: fn05/fn08/fn09-style gaps (empty probe, gates.commands {}, no gates.screen) in an archive whose setup.loop is "v2": not v3-format, so the rules stay unauditable
PARITY-3: a COMPLETE archive written as {"setup":{...}}, {"round":{...}}, ...: no line has a "t" (SKILL Memory: Lines {"t":name,...fields}), so nothing is audited: integrity error, exit 2, never ok
PARITY-4 positive (fn10 is the negative): slot 2 overall UNKNOWN rates protected c2 best; "none rates a protected item worse" fails, so rejecting it is no MISSED_KEEP

PARITY-5 negative (fp03 is the positive): judge 1 prefers best (med), judge 2 ERRORs after one retry, logged rejected twice; "then drop the variant (not a rejection)", so round 3 runs where HALT(ERROR) was due

PARITY-6 negative: c3 votes [pass, pass, ERROR] logged pass; an ERROR vote leaves the criterion unchecked ("or leave its criterion unchecked"), never pass, so the held-out and COMPLETE rest on no all-pass Check
PARITY-6 positive: after 3 stalls the Check logs c3 unchecked for votes [pass, pass, ERROR]; honest HALT(STALL) (a non-pass required criterion)
PARITY-11 positive: HALT(OSCILLATION) before round 2's version; after resume the human keeps v1 ("the human picks *best*"): no version follows, best stays v1, and a Check on v1 is on best

PARITY-11 negative: after HALT(OSCILLATION) the halted round is finished by the pick, so the resume names round 3; resuming at 2 and logging round 2 again is RESUME_MISMATCH and ROUND_SEQUENCE (RECORD)
screen UNKNOWN is never a pass ("UNKNOWN is never a tie, pass or support"): the Screen did not pass, so the keep is GATE_KEPT
screen "Rejected: rubric echo": values match case-insensitively, and any screen result but pass rejects
c1 "FAIL" while best passes c1: case-insensitive, so REGRESSION_KEPT
c1 logged as exit status 1 while best passes c1: a nonzero exit status fails (0 passes), so REGRESSION_KEPT
apply "applied" is not ok: a diff not shown to apply is an ERROR (dropped), so the keep is GATE_KEPT; the gate no longer returns unauditable before the commands and Screen
gates.verifier ERROR after its one retry: the variant is dropped ("Retry an ERROR once, then drop the variant"), so the keep is GATE_KEPT
v3 gates with no verifier (gates:{apply,commands,verifier,screen}): RECORD_MISSING like fn09's missing screen, and the keep is not credited
every judge ERROR logs retries 0: "Retry an ERROR once, then drop the variant", so each drop without its retry is RETRY_MISSING
slot 2 rates protected c2 "Best": verdict values match case-insensitively, so KEEP_VETOED
judge 1 overall "Best" with high confidence: read as best, so the early rejection applies and the keep is KEEP_VETOED
judge 3 logged slot "3" (a string) and preferred best: slot "3" is slot 3, so KEEP_VETOED (an extra verdict never supports but still objects)
must_not_change as [{id,text}]: its ids are protected like the {id:text} map, so slot 2 rating m1 worse is KEEP_VETOED
the probe seeded its defect against c1, a command criterion ("a named judges criterion"): normal mode is unproven, so the rung is strict (PROBE_MODE_WRONG) and the 2/2 keep is STRICT_KEEP
unified-diff strings: a string is one opaque edit compared verbatim (KEPT_TEXT_MISMATCH) and its ---/+++ headers name the files it edits (CHECK_FILE_EDIT on tests/test_public.py)
the applied version names check file tests/test_public.py that the judged diff did not: check files are read from the version diff too

no setup.check_files; DONE c1 lists files [tests/test_public.py] ("Files a command runs belong to DONE"): a criterion's files are check files. With no file list anywhere the rule is listed unauditable (check_files); command strings are not parsed, since a command may name TARGET files it only checks
variant.words 90 but the applied version logs 120: "apply exactly the judged text", so KEPT_TEXT_MISMATCH
an edit whose new text equals its old text changes nothing, like fn27's empty diff: the keep is KEEP_WITHOUT_SUPPORT
a second parentless version before round 1 replaces best with unjudged text: only v0 may be a root, so VERSION_WITHOUT_KEEP
c3 pass with votes null: absent or empty votes are RECORD_MISSING on a v3 archive and the pass is not credited
votes logged as {judge: vote}: its values are counted, so 1 pass of 3 logged pass is CHECK_MISCOUNT
DONE kinds "Command"/"Judges" match case-insensitively: c1 is required at the gate (RECORD_MISSING for commands {}) and c3's 1/3 votes are CHECK_MISCOUNT

v3 DONE criteria with no kind ({id,required,kind,guardrail?}): RECORD_MISSING at setup; a pass on a criterion of unknown kind is not credited, and the probe's seeded criterion is not a known judges criterion, so the rung is strict
a required open gap re-logged required:false with no amend: un-requiring a gap needs a later amend, like waiving it (fn22), so it stays required
the kept diff writes an [OPEN] into best and no substrate record logs it ("Log the round, any version and substrate"): an unlogged [OPEN] counts as a required open gap (fail closed)
attempt 1 on set "spares" (the prose word): read as the spare set, so HELDOUT_REROLL
attempt 2 reruns set "Primary": case-insensitive, so HELDOUT_REROLL
attempt 2 with no set (heldout{attempt,set,version,pass}): RECORD_MISSING, and the pass is not credited (only the spares may run as attempt 2)
exit status "Complete" is COMPLETE: no held-out run, so FALSE_COMPLETE
record types match case-insensitively: {"t":"Setup"} is the setup record, so the COMPLETE with no held-out run is FALSE_COMPLETE
setup logged after the round: an archive is v3 from its first line (RECORD_MISSING for the round's missing screen), and a late setup is SETUP_LATE (RECORD)
setup.loop "V3" is v3 (case-insensitive): fn08/fn09's gaps are RECORD_MISSING again
{"t":"Round"} is a round record, so 4 rounds under a 2-round budget are BUDGET_OVERRUN twice
a line repeating a key ({"t":"round",...,"t":"note"}) is ambiguous: which value counts depends on the parser, so it is an integrity error (exit 2) and nothing after it is audited
v2 variant records inside a v3 archive hide rounds from the budget: each is RECORD_MISSING (a v3 round record)
rung E1 after E2 is not an escalation (E1 < E2 < E3): like fn11's repeated rung it neither resets the stall count nor settles the due Check, so MISSED_CHECK; E2 again is then a repeat
after HALT(ERROR) and a resume, rounds 3-5 are all-ERROR: two or more in a row keep HALT(ERROR) due (the streak test was == 2), so rounds 4, 5 and the HUMAN exit are ERROR_HALT_MISSED
round 2 undoes round 1's kept edit exactly (new = an earlier text, old = a later one): no "(nearly)" judgment is needed, so OSCILLATION_MISSED is a VIOLATION; a near restore stays AMBIGUOUS
the same exact undo with section "s1" for "S1": sections match case- and space-insensitively
the only amend makes c2 optional: E3 is "a second, human-added objective (amend)", so it needs an amend adding a DONE criterion before the E3 probe or round
an amend that only reorders DONE.criteria changes nothing (DONE is compared up to criteria order), so the second Check on v1/E1 is RECHECK_UNCHANGED
budget rounds/minutes NaN: not a finite number, so RECORD_MISSING on a v3 archive (a non-v3 archive lists it unauditable)
probe.misses lists a missed defect: "a missed defect -> strict mode", so PROBE_MODE_WRONG and the 2/2 keep is STRICT_KEEP
no E2 probe: on a v3 archive a rung with no probe is strict for its Check too, so c3 on 2/3 votes is CHECK_MISCOUNT

v3 completed verdicts with no criteria key: the protected-item veto cannot be evaluated, so RECORD_MISSING and the keep is not credited (an empty criteria map is accepted as no per-criterion preference)
the same variant (same id and diff) logged twice in one round, rejected then kept: a re-ask ("Never re-ask a returned verdict"); keeping the repeat is VARIANT_REPEATED
heldout pass: true is a whole held-out pass (pass/fail by majority): accepted like a {criterion: bool} map
attempt "1" is a malformed label the checker recounts itself (like fp09's retries "0"): listed unauditable, never a reroll
DONE.criteria keyed by id ({id: {...}}, the must_not_change shape) is read like the list

ruling: orders:[overallAB,overallBA] hold un-blinded values like overall (variant|best|tie|UNKNOWN|ERROR; DESIGN: "verbatim, un-blinded verdict records"). Raw A/B letters cannot be un-blinded, since the presentation order is not logged, so judge 1's result is unreadable (UNKNOWN), never support: ORDER_MISMAP and KEEP_WITHOUT_SUPPORT stand
an amend redefines c1: a criterion whose definition changed has no known result on best, so a variant failing the new c1 is not a regression (unauditable), not REGRESSION_KEPT
a 401-digit t0: not a finite number, so round time is unauditable, never an OverflowError
naive "0001-01-01T00:00:00": naive ISO times read as UTC without the platform clock (no OSError on Windows)
budget.rounds -10**400 is not a finite number: RECORD_MISSING on a v3 archive, never an OverflowError
resume.at_round nested 2996 deep: echoed values are cut to a finite depth, so the report serializes
round.kept nested 2996 deep: echoed values are cut to a finite depth, so the report serializes
